label: VS Code
headline: VS Code Cheat Sheet
description: Quick reference for the VS Code keyboard shortcuts and commands you reach for every day — from editing and navigation to multi-cursor, search, and the terminal.

items.name: Command Palette
items.definition: Open the command palette to search and run any VS Code command.

items.name: Quick Open
items.definition: Quickly open a file by name.

items.name: New Window
items.definition: Open a new VS Code window or instance.

items.name: Close Window
items.definition: Close the current window or instance.

items.name: User Settings
items.definition: Open the user settings editor.

items.name: Keyboard Shortcuts
items.definition: Open the keyboard shortcuts editor.

items.name: Cut Line
items.definition: Cut the current line (no selection needed).

items.name: Copy Line
items.definition: Copy the current line (no selection needed).

items.name: Move Line Up/Down
items.definition: Move the current line up or down.

items.name: Copy Line Up/Down
items.definition: Duplicate the current line above or below.

items.name: Delete Line
items.definition: Delete the entire current line.

items.name: Insert Line Below
items.definition: Insert a new line below the current line.

items.name: Insert Line Above
items.definition: Insert a new line above the current line.

items.name: Jump to Bracket
items.definition: Jump to the matching opening or closing bracket.

items.name: Indent Line
items.definition: Indent the current line one level to the right.

items.name: Outdent Line
items.definition: Outdent the current line one level to the left.

items.name: Go to Start of File
items.definition: Move the cursor to the very beginning of the file.

items.name: Go to End of File
items.definition: Move the cursor to the very end of the file.

items.name: Fold Region
items.definition: Collapse the current code region.

items.name: Unfold Region
items.definition: Expand the current collapsed code region.

items.name: Fold All
items.definition: Collapse all foldable code regions in the file.

items.name: Unfold All
items.definition: Expand all collapsed code regions in the file.

items.name: Toggle Line Comment
items.definition: Comment or uncomment the current line.

items.name: Toggle Block Comment
items.definition: Wrap or unwrap the selection in a block comment.

items.name: Toggle Word Wrap
items.definition: Toggle soft word wrapping for long lines.

items.name: Go to Line
items.definition: Jump directly to a specific line number.

items.name: Go to Symbol
items.definition: Navigate to a symbol (function, class, variable) in the current file.

items.name: Show All Symbols
items.definition: Search for any symbol across all open files.

items.name: Problems Panel
items.definition: Open the Problems panel showing errors and warnings.

items.name: Next Error/Warning
items.definition: Jump to the next error or warning in the file.

items.name: Previous Error/Warning
items.definition: Jump to the previous error or warning in the file.

items.name: Go Back
items.definition: Navigate back to the previous cursor location.

items.name: Go Forward
items.definition: Navigate forward to the next cursor location.

items.name: Go to Definition
items.definition: Jump to the definition of the symbol under the cursor.

items.name: Peek Definition
items.definition: Show the definition inline without leaving the current file.

items.name: Show References
items.definition: Show all references to the symbol under the cursor.

items.name: Find
items.definition: Open the find bar to search within the current file.

items.name: Replace
items.definition: Open find and replace in the current file.

items.name: Find Next
items.definition: Jump to the next match for the current search term.

items.name: Find Previous
items.definition: Jump to the previous match for the current search term.

items.name: Select All Matches
items.definition: Select every occurrence of the current search match.

items.name: Add Next Match
items.definition: Add the next occurrence of the selected word to the selection.

items.name: Search in Files
items.definition: Open the global search panel to search across all files.

items.name: Replace in Files
items.definition: Open global search and replace across all files.

items.name: Add Cursor
items.definition: Add an additional cursor at the clicked position.

items.name: Add Cursor Above
items.definition: Add a new cursor on the line above.

items.name: Add Cursor Below
items.definition: Add a new cursor on the line below.

items.name: Undo Cursor
items.definition: Remove the most recently added cursor.

items.name: Select Current Line
items.definition: Select the entire current line.

items.name: Select All Occurrences
items.definition: Select every occurrence of the current selection.

items.name: Expand Selection
items.definition: Expand the selection to the next logical block.

items.name: Shrink Selection
items.definition: Shrink the selection to the previous logical block.

items.name: Column Selection
items.definition: Drag to create a rectangular (box) multi-line selection.

items.name: Trigger Suggestion
items.definition: Manually trigger IntelliSense code completion suggestions.

items.name: Parameter Hints
items.definition: Show parameter hints for the current function call.

items.name: Format Document
items.definition: Auto-format the entire file using the configured formatter.

items.name: Format Selection
items.definition: Format only the currently selected code.

items.name: Quick Fix
items.definition: Show available quick fixes and refactoring actions.

items.name: Rename Symbol
items.definition: Rename a symbol and update all its references across files.

items.name: Trim Whitespace
items.definition: Remove trailing whitespace from all lines.

items.name: Change Language
items.definition: Change the syntax highlighting language for the current file.

items.name: Close Editor
items.definition: Close the current editor tab.

items.name: Reopen Closed Editor
items.definition: Reopen the most recently closed editor tab.

items.name: Split Editor
items.definition: Split the editor into two side-by-side panes.

items.name: Focus Editor Group 1/2/3
items.definition: Switch focus to the first, second, or third editor group.

items.name: Next Tab
items.definition: Switch to the next open editor tab.

items.name: Previous Tab
items.definition: Switch to the previous open editor tab.

items.name: Close All Editors
items.definition: Close every open editor tab.

items.name: New File
items.definition: Create a new untitled file.

items.name: Open File
items.definition: Open an existing file from disk.

items.name: Save
items.definition: Save the current file.

items.name: Save As
items.definition: Save the current file under a new name or location.

items.name: Save All
items.definition: Save all open unsaved files at once.

items.name: Copy File Path
items.definition: Copy the full path of the active file to the clipboard.

items.name: Reveal in Explorer
items.definition: Reveal the active file in the OS file explorer (Finder/Explorer).

items.name: Toggle Sidebar
items.definition: Show or hide the left sidebar panel.

items.name: Toggle Full Screen
items.definition: Enter or exit full screen mode.

items.name: Zoom In
items.definition: Increase the editor zoom level.

items.name: Zoom Out
items.definition: Decrease the editor zoom level.

items.name: Show Explorer
items.definition: Open the file explorer panel.

items.name: Show Source Control
items.definition: Open the Git source control panel.

items.name: Show Extensions
items.definition: Open the extensions marketplace panel.

items.name: Show Output
items.definition: Open the output panel to see logs.

items.name: Markdown Preview
items.definition: Open a side-by-side Markdown preview.

items.name: Zen Mode
items.definition: Enter distraction-free Zen Mode. Press Esc twice to exit.

items.name: Start / Continue
items.definition: Start debugging or continue after a breakpoint pause.

items.name: Stop Debug
items.definition: Stop the current debug session.

items.name: Toggle Breakpoint
items.definition: Add or remove a breakpoint on the current line.

items.name: Step Over
items.definition: Execute the current line and pause on the next one.

items.name: Step Into
items.definition: Step into the function call on the current line.

items.name: Step Out
items.definition: Step out of the current function back to the caller.

items.name: Show Hover
items.definition: Show the debug hover tooltip for the value under the cursor.

items.name: Toggle Terminal
items.definition: Show or hide the integrated terminal panel.

items.name: New Terminal
items.definition: Open a new integrated terminal instance.

items.name: Scroll Up
items.definition: Scroll the terminal output up one line.

items.name: Scroll Down
items.definition: Scroll the terminal output down one line.

items.name: Scroll to Top
items.definition: Jump to the very top of the terminal output.

items.name: Scroll to Bottom
items.definition: Jump to the very bottom of the terminal output.
